reason: The PR makes branch-variable reliability directional: an up or down pseudocost may be reused independently at a node instead of requiring both directions to be reliable. This can change strong-branching LP work, selected variables, bounds, and the search tree. A small hash-table clear change is secondary and must remain in the source-only patch.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: Using reliable up and down pseudocosts independently can avoid unnecessary strong-branch LP solves and change branching choices on MIPs with asymmetric directional evidence, improving proof time on some structures but possibly expanding other search trees.
causal_chain: At a fractional candidate, the PR reads a two-bit node-reliability flag and fills up and down estimates separately. That changes which directions require strong-branch evaluation, the resulting branching score, chosen variable, and all downstream node bounds. Hash-table clear behavior also changes the cost of state resets.
structural_trigger: Branch nodes with fractional integer candidates whose node-local reliability is known in exactly one direction; nodes with both or neither directions reliable are controls.
activation_probe: Count one-direction reliability states, skipped versus executed strong-branch LP evaluations, selected branching variables, and node counts in both pinned variants on public MIPs before hidden scoring.
instance_selection_rule: Freeze public and held-out MIP families by branching asymmetry, cut density, and difficulty before hidden scoring; keep fixed CPU-time budgets, seeds, threads, and a family where directional reliability rarely occurs.
workload_exposure_plan: Build pinned base and source-only PR images, run the shared exact MIP driver, instrument partial-reliability and strong-branch paths on public binary and general-integer cases, and retain complete original-model solve and bound records.
mathematical_risk: A stale or misinterpreted reliability flag can lead to an incorrect branching score, skipped search region, invalid bound, or false optimality/infeasibility status; floating-point LP differences may amplify search errors.
independent_check_plan: Verify primal solutions against original MIP models and compare bound/status/optimality claims with independent SCIP solves or mathematical certificates on tractable public cases, including normal timeouts.
hidden_generalization_plan: Report independently verified solved coverage, proof time, timeout bounds/gaps, and per-family regressions on hidden ID and held-out MIP structures with paired fixed resources and all missing runs retained.
overlap_review: Directional branch reliability is separate from PR #690's cut-aging mechanism and later presolve work. Check nearby pseudocost and strong-branching PRs for duplicated source hunks before counting another branching task.
resource_risk: A changed candidate order can enlarge the search tree despite fewer local LP solves; extra flag handling and hash-table resets may also change memory or per-node overhead.
